answer: Yes. tools/checkout_quarantine.enter_untrusted_checkout quarantines .claude/, .codex/, .mcp.json and hooks/ before simulating agent auto-load. With quarantine ON the canary marker is absent and the quarantine report enumerates all four surfaces (CVE-2026-47751-class on .codex/). With quarantine OFF the same canary writes FIRED: tags for every surface, so the detector is live. Catalog owner_approval_required=true is a dispatch gate; this receipt is the technical test, not an owner legal ruling. SUCCESS:TST-0216

evidence.method: tempfile hostile checkout planted with four auto-load surfaces plus benign canaries; enter_untrusted_checkout both-states (quarantine ON vs OFF) and a clean-tree negative control

notes: G-1 TST-0216: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. SUCCESS:TST-0216
owner_approval_note: Catalog owner_approval_required=true excludes this unit from auto-dispatch. This artifact is the technical G-1 delivery of the quarantine test; it does not grant owner sign-off and does not mutate live trees.
question: When a checkout contains `.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.mcp.json` or hooks, does the toolchain quarantine and report them before any agent runs inside it? PASS requires zero hook execution from the untrusted tree, proven by a canary hook that would write a marker.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 is the required detector control: the identical canary must write its marker when quarantine is disabled, proving the probe can observe execution. Catalog two-vendor human review is independent of G-1 probe-green.

scanners.mechanism: plant a canary hook that appends FIRED:<surface> to a marker path outside the checkout; after enter_untrusted_checkout with quarantine ON the marker file must be absent or empty
scanners.name: canary-marker-filesystem

scanners.mechanism: scan checkout-root .claude/, .codex/, .mcp.json and hooks/, move each hit into .ast-quarantine/, and emit QUARANTINE-REPORT.json listing every surface; independent of the marker file
scanners.name: quarantine-report-enumeration

tests.notes: quarantine ON: marker absent; all four surfaces enumerated and moved
quarantine OFF: same canary writes FIRED: for all four surfaces
checkout with no auto-load surfaces enumerates nothing and writes no marker

title: A cloned repo carrying auto-load agent config is quarantined, not executed
